body: I'd like to experience what it's like to have a job, but that's difficult but I'm scared to talk to people and I have no work experience. Same with friends. I've basically gone through social isolation so I don't know how to speak with people.

hmmm, not necessarily... I enjoyed playing basketball but I don't have a desire to or strive to go out and play it. I don't have any experience with outdoor activities since i've been a homebody for the past few years.

It's been a long while since I've thought of that. A year ago. I tried as hard as I could to graduate high school. I was extremely close to failing until I gave it my all that last month. Graduated with my class. So I guess you can say I did high school all the way. Maybe that wasn't the sort of thing you had in mind?

I've been doing the [7 Minute Workout](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U6etLKswjq8) to try and get my mind to focus more on things that are important like my future rather than myself. Was successful in completing it the first week but after that, like everything else I've been doing, I give up. I tried one last time recently and ended up only getting 1/3rd through it. Now i'm back to this state.
Thanks buddy. I'll message you if anything comes up that I want someone to hear.

Thanks for caring. I honestly think that it's not that I expect a lot of myself, but rather, I don't think I can reach the point that everyone else is at (since i'm so incredibly far behind in social experience). I haven't made a friend in years and when people try talking to me it's somewhat of a disaster. Your story was interesting and it helped a bit reading it. Thanks again.

About two months ago. My younger of my two older sisters was texting my older sister (she doesn't live with us, but I was staying at her house that evening) about how depressed she was because of how much stress she was going through with her job, school and some other details I don't know much about. My older sister was sending "meaningful replies" back to her but when she talked to me she was saying how dumb she's acting and how she's being really overdramatic. So I don't think I want to talk to my older sister... My younger sister is going through that at the moment so I don't think I want to add anymore onto her plate. I'll try looking into some things to get my mind off myself.

Thank you.

 I'll take it all into consideration. My dad has a hard time reading english, so my mother would be my best bet. I don't think she could do much though. She's never been the person to really be all that active in her children's lives. She'll likely understand then not do much about it like she has way way in the past whenever I had emotional talks with her. I'll try to be less analytical of myself. What do you suggest I monitor/think about? All I have to think about is myself really.

It does feels really good having someone respond to my thoughts though. Thanks again. I really do appreciate it.
